name: CORPONATION FUTURES EXCHANGE: Gray Pool Edition
description: A gray-market derivative of the legal Corponation Futures Exchange, the Gray Pool Edition operates outside Meridian Securities oversight by routing through three offshore mesh relays and denominating positions in anonymous Quanta vouchers rather than registered accounts. Users bet on corponation stock movements, merger announcements, executive departures, and regulatory outcomes with leverage up to 40x. The platform is widely believed to be operated by a consortium of mid-level Axiom finance employees moonlighting on their own infrastructure.
story_hooks: A Tier 2 warehouse worker keeps winning massive positions on Axiom logistics contracts — she's not hacking, she's just listening to what drivers say.
Someone placed a Φ 200,000 leveraged position betting on a corponation's collapse — and the collapse hasn't happened yet, but it will.
The Gray Pool's anonymous voucher system has been compromised; someone is building a list of every trader's identity.
